name: Kanapon Japanese
description: App Store & Play Store screenshots for a Japanese learning, kana flashcard or language app. White and warm yellow artboards with thick black outlines, hard sticker shadows, red label pills and bold Poppins headlines, led by Pon, an original daruma mascot in six poses. Kana word tags float around an outlined phone, audio tiles pop out of a listening quiz, hiragana tiles unlock row by row, quiz answers lift off the screen, and a goal board shows the daruma custom of painting one eye when you start and the other when you get there. A faint wave pattern, laurel stats and every sticker are shapes you can recolor, and every part sits in a named layer group.
